entries.e511a28ad56a8d6d: In its medium-term management plan "V Plan 26" (the 3 years from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), under the Group mission "Creating new happiness by heating," it sets out as priority strategies the transformation of its business portfolio, expansion of strategic investment and capital policy, and promotion of sustainability management.

entries.ebd96bbec871f39c: In the medium-term management plan "V Plan 26" (3 years from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2026), under the group mission "Heating up new happiness," it sets out as priority strategies the transformation of the business portfolio, expansion of strategic investment and capital policy, and the promotion of sustainability management. In domestic business, it corrects the heavy reliance on the residential hot water field by expanding the non-residential and kitchen fields, and in overseas business, it reduces dependence on the China area while expanding the North America area and developing in Southeast Asia. The sales target for the fiscal year ending December 2026, the final year, is ¥210 billion (¥140 billion in domestic business and ¥70 billion in overseas business).
